# /etc/sections/01

## $ ls -la {.cmd-slide}

```{=html}
<pre class="terminal-block">
<span class="user">guest@deck ~</span><span class="dollar">$</span><span class="cmd"> ls -la</span>
drwxr-xr-x  intro.md         2k
drwxr-xr-x  evidence.md      5k
drwxr-xr-x  case-study.md    9k
<span class="dim">-rw-r--r--  TODO.md          0k</span>
</pre>
```

- Each row is one talking point
- The cursor is the eyebrow
- [Bright green = answer; dim grey = aside.]{.dim}

## $ cat ./snippet.sh {.cmd-slide}

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in *.log; do
  grep -E 'ERROR|WARN' "$f" \
    | awk -F'\t' '{print $1, $3}' \
    | sort -u
done
```

[> exit 0]{.caret}
